title: Gluten-Free Vietnamese Beef Pho
description: A gluten-free version of the classic Vietnamese noodle soup, pho, made with beef broth and topped with fresh herbs.
instructions: In a large stockpot, combine beef bones, onion, ginger, fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, star anise, and cinnamon stick.
Pour in 4 cups of water and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Add beef brisket to the stockpot and cook for an additional 30 minutes.
Remove beef from the stockpot and slice into thin strips.
Cook rice noodles according to package instructions.
Assemble pho by placing noodles in a bowl, topping with sliced beef, and serving with fresh herbs.
